note: `coverage.unmapped_threshold_bytes` overridden from 32 to 999999 — the reviewer's attempt to exempt the card from the omission scan entirely by inflating the bar it declares for itself. It does not work even on its own terms: verify-traces.mjs reads the REAL bar out of the schema's top-level `unmappedThresholdBytes` (32) and uses that for the scan regardless of what the card claims, then separately checks that the card's restatement agrees with the profile. A card that disagrees fails right there, before the scan it was trying to disable ever runs.
